title: Solo Leveling and Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint Confirm a Brand New Project in North America
content: Solo Leveling is easily the most popular and influential manhwa series of all time, paving the path for the entire medium’s success. While the manhwa and light novel were already globally famous, the anime adaptation by A-1 Pictures turned it into a global phenomenon.

Fate/kaleid’s production committee announced that Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya Finale, a TV anime sequel to Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya: Licht Nameless Girl, will conclude the series.
